title: Lessons Learned Building Apps with LangChain: Panel Discussion
summary: Four builders share LangChain lessons on version pinning, debugging, model changes and hallucinations.

chapters.title: Graph Transformations and Ollama Tool Calling
LangServe and FastAPI over Google Drive

learn: Lock down library versions: before 0.1, LangChain code that worked one day could break the next.
Debug agents one chain at a time with LangSmith and print statements instead of testing the whole system at once.
Name the exact model version you use, because results shift when the provider upgrades a model.
Karim Lalani reworked an old Ollama tool-calling library to add structured output and bind tools, and got the change merged.
Robert Kessler gives answers an audit trail that links to the source passage, to help with hallucinations.
